description:
Welcome to this newly refurbished property located on Baldwin Street in the vibrant city of Bristol. This spacious apartment is perfect for families or professional sharers seeking a comfortable and modern living space in a central location. 

The property boasts six well-appointed bedrooms, providing ample space for everyone. With one reception room, it offers a welcoming area for relaxation and socialising. The two bathrooms ensure convenience for all residents, making morning routines and evening unwinding a breeze.

Situated in the heart of Bristol, this property benefits from easy access to a variety of local amenities, including shops, restaurants, and public transport links. The central location allows for a lively lifestyle, with the city's attractions just a short walk away.

This property is an excellent opportunity for those looking to enjoy the best of city living while having a comfortable and stylish home. Don't miss the chance to make this newly refurbished space your own.

The Flat - 

Reception/ Kitchen - 5.00m x 4.80m (16' 5" x 15' 9")

Bathroom - 2.40m x 2.50m (7' 10" x 8' 2")

Bathroom. - 2.60m x 1.60m (8' 6" x 5' 3")

Bedroom 1 - 5.60m x 2.60m (18' 4" x 8' 6")

Bedroom 2 - 4.20m x 2.70m (13' 9" x 8' 10")

Bedroom 3 - 3.70m x 2.20m (12' 2" x 7' 3")

Bedroom 4 - 3.60m x 3.70m (11' 10" x 12' 2")

Bedroom 5 - 3.70m x 4.00m (12' 2" x 13' 1")

Bedroom 6 - 3.60m x 4.30m (11' 10" x 14' 1")

Full Description - FULLY FURNISHED STUDENT OR PROFESSIONAL SHARERS PROPERTY. AVAILABLE BEGINNING OF JULY 2023. An this amazing 6 bedroom flat is in the heart of Bristol City Centre and is ready and waiting for you to move in to. The flat offers two bathrooms, a kitchen/living room and 5 doubles and 1 single bedrooms with beds, desk wardrobes and chest of drawers. This is a fantastic opportunity for students to live within the close distance to Bristol University and enjoy all the amenities of the city right at their front door.
£595.00 per room, property is not rented as individual rooms, property as one whole let.
